stories.title: Asian Games gold in hand, Lee Hyun-jung readies for another shot at NBA dream

en.title: Asian Games gold in hand, Lee Hyun-jung readies for another shot at NBA dream
en.summary: Lee Hyun-jung, a 25-year-old forward, scored 27 points and grabbed 18 rebounds in South Korea's 67-57 victory over Japan in the Asian Games men's basketball final. Korea achieved a perfect 6-0 tournament record and claimed its first Asian Games basketball gold on foreign soil since 1982.
